experiment: Official MoEQuant EBSS calibration-quality validation (cross-checkpoint transfer, provenance undocumented)
central_question: Does the released EBSS_qwen.jsonl yield lower held-out expert reconstruction error and partial-model PPL than C4 Full Random and Typical Random under the identical GPTQ pipeline?
calibration: non-sequential; Hessians from CANONICAL-B1 layer inputs via the unchanged E3 Profiler (K = 4)
reconstruction: E3 per-expert held-out relative reconstruction on ~/moe_cache rows 2128-2255 (eval_cache_dir); config score = mean over the 240 experts (unchanged aggregation)
exposure_deciles: deciles of each expert's natural routing frequency p (runs_low_budget/routing_profile_v2.npz, C4 pool), fixed and method-independent
typicality: existing d(s) (moe_calib.typicality) against the C4-pool reference of routing_profile_v2; atypical = d(s) > d*, d* = largest d in the frozen typical half (pool_typical_half.json)

decision_rule.precedence: 1 data availability -> 2 numerical / quantization correctness -> 3 source-checkpoint provenance -> 4 reconstruction and PPL criteria
decision_rule.DATA-BLOCKED: the official file cannot be acquired / parsed, or the frozen extraction policy yields fewer than 128 valid 512-token windows
decision_rule.RUN-BLOCKED: a primary configuration (FR/TR/FC s0-2, EBSS) is missing or invalid (install check, untouched parameters, non-finite or unchanged projections, repeat-evaluation PPL difference != 0, RTN fallback in a C4 baseline), the quantization-pipeline regression (FR s0 on the historical cache) does not reproduce the partial-PPL weights/PPL/reconstruction exactly, the extraction implementation regression or the batch-1 repeatability control fails, or the BF16 PPL differs from 9.237090
decision_rule.OFFICIAL-EBSS-TRANSFER-LIMITED: provenance class != MATCHED-DOCUMENTED (generating checkpoint differs or cannot be established). Takes precedence over the quality classes; the quality class that would otherwise apply is still reported

quality criteria.R (reconstruction gain): EBSS mean expert reconstruction < FR_s and < TR_s for s = 0, 1, 2 AND mean_s RelativePenalty(EBSS, FR_s) <= -0.5 % AND mean_s RelativePenalty(EBSS, TR_s) <= -0.5 %
quality criteria.P (PPL gain): EBSS PPL < FR_s and < TR_s PPL for s = 0, 1, 2 (matched protocol)

decision_rule.notes: FC is a negative control and is not part of R or P. One EBSS set: no EBSS SD is computed; experts are not treated as independent replications.

hard_constraints: no GPTQ / solver / bit / group / damping / checkpoint change; no AGQ, rotation or new allocator; no EBSS regeneration or C4 mixing; no tuning on held-out results; one EBSS set; no numerical-sensitivity sweep
